label: Reference scope disputed
decision_rule: Gold positive is not a purpose, own-project design decision/proposal, privacy/AML position, legal-tender or monetary-role statement
required_protocol_response: Resolve reference label before prompt tuning; document correction

label: Substantive conclusion missed
decision_rule: A clear in-scope conclusion, decision or proposal is present but no model output covers it
required_protocol_response: Add conclusion-first instruction and block-level recall pass

label: v9 codebook gap
decision_rule: The paragraph is in v10 scope but lacks a suitable code in the 19-code v9 prompt
required_protocol_response: Use the frozen 35-code v10 codebook; keep relevance screening separate from coding

label: Own-project attribution missed
decision_rule: The statement concerns the issuing authority's own project but the model treats it as foreign/background
required_protocol_response: Add issuer/project metadata and an explicit scope field

label: Long-page context loss
decision_rule: Relevant text is truncated, buried, or omitted on a long page
required_protocol_response: Deterministic block chunking with overlap and no tail truncation

label: Layout/list/table loss
decision_rule: Reading order, headings, columns, bullets or tables obscure the claim
required_protocol_response: Use layout-aware blocks/render fallback and preserve block IDs

label: Language/translation failure
decision_rule: Relevant non-English text is missed or mistranslated
required_protocol_response: Freeze language handling; retain original quote and separate translation

label: OCR/source-layer failure
decision_rule: Relevant content is absent or materially corrupted in extracted text
required_protocol_response: Use frozen OCR/render fallback or explicit unresolved-source status

label: Matcher false negative
decision_rule: The model produced a valid span but deterministic alignment failed
required_protocol_response: Fix matcher or offsets without changing semantic prompt

label: Output limit or premature deduplication
decision_rule: The claim is omitted because of output limits, list compression, or deduplication
required_protocol_response: Archive raw exhaustive output; deduplicate after recall measurement

label: Other FN
decision_rule: No listed FN rule fits
required_protocol_response: Describe mechanism and add a narrowly scoped corrective action

label: Existing code misassigned
decision_rule: The model extracted a supported in-scope statement but assigned an incorrect existing family
required_protocol_response: Retain the verified span, correct the code, and test classification rules; do not treat it as a pure extraction-recall miss

label: Foreign project or research
decision_rule: Output reports another jurisdiction, cited literature, or a hypothetical study rather than the issuer's own position
required_protocol_response: Require explicit own-project scope evidence in every output

label: General talk without a claim
decision_rule: Heading, topic list, aspiration or broad prose contains no substantive design assertion
required_protocol_response: Require a complete assertion and conclusion/proposal test

label: Possibility without issuer position
decision_rule: Text discusses what could happen but the issuer neither proposes nor decides it
required_protocol_response: Separate scenario/research from an issuer proposal

label: Process/future research only
decision_rule: Output describes study, consultation or testing with no retained process/design claim
required_protocol_response: Retain only codebook-eligible process evidence; otherwise exclude

label: Keyword or heading extraction
decision_rule: A code is assigned to an isolated heading, label or noun phrase
required_protocol_response: Minimum complete-clause rule; contextual assertion required

label: Code definition overreach
decision_rule: The quote is substantive but does not meet the selected code's inclusion rule
required_protocol_response: Classify after relevance; enforce code-specific inclusion/exclusion rules

label: Matcher assigned wrong paragraph
decision_rule: A valid statement is aligned to the wrong negative paragraph on the same page
required_protocol_response: Audit block IDs and tighten deterministic alignment

label: Reference false negative
decision_rule: The model output is in scope and the human negative label is wrong
required_protocol_response: Correct and version the reference standard before freeze

label: Fragment without support
decision_rule: Quote fragments alter or remove the substantive meaning
required_protocol_response: Require source-bounded complete spans

label: Other FP
decision_rule: No listed FP rule fits
required_protocol_response: Describe mechanism and add a narrowly scoped corrective action

label: PDF normalization only
decision_rule: Source supports the words after deterministic whitespace/hyphen normalization
required_protocol_response: Map normalized span back to real offsets and retain audit trail

label: OCR-equivalent
decision_rule: Rendered page supports the quote but OCR/PDF text differs materially
required_protocol_response: Store render hash, OCR text and equivalence adjudication

label: Model paraphrase
decision_rule: Meaning is supported but quote is not verbatim
required_protocol_response: Reject quoted span; retry once from source block

label: Translation used as quote
decision_rule: Original-language quote field contains translated or reconstructed text
required_protocol_response: Keep original quote and translation in separate validated fields

label: Wrong page
decision_rule: Quote exists elsewhere but not on the cited page
required_protocol_response: Reject and correct provenance only through documented rerun

label: Unsupported statement
decision_rule: Neither source layer nor render supports the claim
required_protocol_response: Reject statement and count span failure/false positive

label: Source unavailable
decision_rule: Source cannot be checked from the frozen package
required_protocol_response: Do not score as verified; resolve source before freeze

label: Other span failure
decision_rule: No listed span rule fits
required_protocol_response: Describe mechanism and add a deterministic verifier response
